description_en: Submits a video translation task that supports subtitle translation, voice translation, and on-screen text translation
description_zh: 用于提交视频翻译任务，支持字幕、声音及画面文字翻译等功能
kebab_example: aliyun yike submit-video-translation-job --job-type VoiceTranslate --input Video_:_oss://bucket/path/input.mp4 --biz-output OssUri_:_oss://bucket/output/ --job-parameters SourceLanguage_:_zh_,_TargetLanguage_:_en_,_NeedDetext_:false,_NeedVisualTranslate_:false --title title --description description --user-data example-string --client-token 00003e761e9d11edba640c42a1b70000 --api-version 2026-07-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitVideoTranslationJob

parameters.help_en:
The job type. Valid values:
SubtitleTranslate
VoiceTranslate
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，支持：
SubtitleTranslate
VoiceTranslate

parameters.help_en:
The input configuration JSON string:
Video
Audio
Subtitle

Video
